initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in upstream provenance ranking. The behavioral criteria require deterministic source provenance to preserve demand-descending rank order. Job 1 preserved the needs records, but its evidence_sources ranked the lowest-demand records first, causing Job 2 to prioritize n06-r07 ahead of the higher-demand unsupported n06-r01. The supplied source for assemble_provenance shows it sorts by demand_score ascending, which directly explains the bad upstream ranks.
